premise: On a foggy morning Sandpiper can't see anything; a chugging shape turns out to be the fishing boat coming home, a bottle rolls up to his feet, and the sun melts the fog away.
inspiration: The fog-and-reveal of sea tales (the ship out of the mist), told with no danger: what was hidden was there all along, and friendly.
lesson: What you can't see is often still there, safe.

en-US.title: The Foggy Morning
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s} [softly] One morning, the beach was hidden in fog, soft and white and grey. {sandpiper:enter} Sandpiper peered out. {sandpiper:face surprised} He couldn't see the water. {sandpiper:live look-around} He couldn't see the lighthouse. [whispers] Where has everything gone? [short pause] {sfx:chug} Chug, chug, chug. Something big was out there. {fishing-boat:enter} A dark shape came slowly through the fog… {fishing-boat:pulse} the fishing boat, coming home. And bobbing along beside it, {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to fishing-boat} a little green bottle. {bottle:go to shore} A wave rolled it right up to the edge. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Sandpiper ran over and gave it a peck. {bottle:live pop} Pop! went the cork. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live laugh} [laughs] Then, {canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s} slowly, the sun broke through, {canvas:fog stop} and the fog melted away. {fishing-boat:live net} The fishing boat hauled up its net, {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to fishing-boat} and Gull flew out to say good morning. {sandpiper:live peck} Sandpiper pecked happily at the ground. [happily] Everything was right where it had been, all along. {sandpiper:hop}

es-ES.title: La mañana de niebla
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s} [softly] Una mañana, la playa amaneció escondida en la niebla, suave, blanca y gris. {sandpiper:enter} Correlimos se asomó. {sandpiper:face surprised} No veía el agua. {sandpiper:live look-around} No veía el faro. [whispers] ¿Dónde se ha ido todo? [short pause] {sfx:chug} Chuc, chuc, chuc. Algo grande había ahí fuera. {fishing-boat:enter} Una sombra se acercaba despacio entre la niebla… {fishing-boat:pulse} la barca de pesca, que volvía a casa. Y meciéndose a su lado, {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to fishing-boat} una botellita verde. {bottle:go to shore} Una ola la llevó rodando hasta el borde. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Correlimos fue corriendo y le dio un picotazo. {bottle:live pop} ¡Pop!, hizo el corcho. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live laugh} [laughs] Entonces, {canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s} poco a poco, salió el sol, {canvas:fog stop} y la niebla se deshizo. {fishing-boat:live net} La barca subió su red, {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to fishing-boat} y Gaviota salió volando a darle los buenos días. {sandpiper:live peck} Correlimos picoteó el suelo, contento. [happily] Todo estaba en su sitio, como siempre. {sandpiper:hop}

ja-JP.title: きりの 朝
ja-JP.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s}[softly]ある朝、うみべは、きりにすっぽりつつまれていました。ふんわり白くて、はいいろの、きり。{sandpiper:enter}シギくんが、きょろり。{sandpiper:face surprised}水が、見えません。{sandpiper:live look-around}とうだいも、見えません。[whispers]みんな、どこへいっちゃったの？[short pause]{sfx:chug}ポン、ポン、ポン。なにか、大きなものがいます。{fishing-boat:enter}くろいかげが、きりのなかから、ゆっくり…{fishing-boat:pulse}漁船です。かえってきたのです。そのよこで、ぷかぷかゆれているのは、{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to fishing-boat}小さなみどりいろのびん。{bottle:go to shore}波が、びんを、波打ち際まで、ころころはこんできました。{sandpiper:go to bottle by run}シギくんは、かけよって、コツン。{bottle:live pop}スポンッ！コルクがぬけました。{sandpiper:face happy}{sandpiper:live laugh}[laughs]それから、{canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s}ゆっくりと、お日さまが顔を出して、{canvas:fog stop}きりは、とけるように、きえていきました。{fishing-boat:live net}漁船があみを引きあげると、{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to fishing-boat}カモメさんが、「おはよう！」 といいに、とんできました。{sandpiper:live peck}シギくんは、うれしそうに、足もとをつんつん。[happily]なにもかも、はじめから、ちゃんとそこにあったのです。{sandpiper:hop}

chug.prompt: a small fishing boat's old engine chugging slowly across calm water, distant, realistic

pop.prompt: a cork popping out of a glass bottle, a gentle pop
